workflow.name: DocAgent - AI Document Generation from Templates
workflow.description: Chat-driven agent that helps users fill legal document templates. Phase 1: list/select template and collect user data via LLM conversation. Phase 2: DocProcess subworkflow — verify choice, format data, copy template, fill placeholders, generate download link.

API_KEY.description: OpenAI-compatible API key for LLM calls

TEMPLATE_DIR.description: Path to local template JSON files

GENERATED_DIR.description: Path where generated documents are saved

workflow_steps.name: list_templates
workflow_steps.description: List all available document templates (mock Google Drive scan)

workflow_steps.name: chat_with_doc_agent
workflow_steps.description: LLM DocAgent: user selects template and provides placeholder values via conversation

workflow_steps.name: get_template_metadata
workflow_steps.description: Fetch metadata (placeholders, conditionals) for the selected template

workflow_steps.name: verify_user_choice
workflow_steps.description: LLM verifies that the template name and ID are correctly matched

workflow_steps.name: get_template_metadata2
workflow_steps.description: Re-fetch latest metadata for the verified template

workflow_steps.name: format_user_data
workflow_steps.description: LLM formats user answers against template metadata into structured data dict

workflow_steps.name: copy_template
workflow_steps.description: Copy template to generated folder to create a working document
